ink.role: Primary typography, compact evidence panels, calibration rails, and the required closing navy band.
ink.rationale: The brand navy remains authoritative, but Direction B uses it with restraint until the final close so white and mist can dominate the atlas system.

action.role: Tiny decision points, selected-path dots, rail ticks, CTA arrows, and focus accents.
action.rationale: Gold is reduced to calibration and action signals, preventing a luxury/casino read and avoiding Direction A's sweeping route line.

mist.role: Clinical atlas fields, contact-sheet backgrounds, blueprint plates, and quiet register panels.
mist.rationale: Mist blue is a dominant B material that makes the system bright, medical, and analytical.

surface.role: Nearly absent warm transition material behind the coordination/problem and planner sections.
surface.rationale: Ivory is intentionally minimized so B does not collapse back into Direction A's warm editorial paper system.

white.role: Dominant page field, caption plates, clipped dossiers, pathway plates, and high-contrast type on navy.
white.rationale: White is the main atlas ground and creates the clinical clarity requested for Direction B.

charcoal.role: Secondary explanatory copy and compliance notes on white, mist, and ivory surfaces.
charcoal.rationale: Charcoal softens long-form reading without introducing an unapproved black or gray palette.

relationships.context: Inter headlines and labels on the dominant atlas field
relationships.intent: Large declarative type remains highly legible on the bright B ground.

relationships.context: Contact-sheet captions, blueprint plates, and register panels
relationships.intent: Clinical mist panels stay readable without darkening the page into A's navy field.

relationships.context: Required closing navy band and compact evidence panels
relationships.intent: White type on navy supports the close and evidence panels with strong contrast.

relationships.context: Body copy, summaries, and compliance notes
relationships.intent: Secondary text remains readable while visually subordinate to navy headings.

relationships.context: Long pathway and register summaries on clinical panels
relationships.intent: Body copy remains accessible on B's clinical mist surfaces.

relationships.context: Rare gold action surfaces or focus accents with text
relationships.intent: When gold appears as a small action surface, navy labels remain accessible.

relationships.context: Warm transition sections that still use B's Inter-led hierarchy
relationships.intent: The minimized ivory surface remains readable and brand-compliant.

image_evidence.influence: Establishes B's bright hero while keeping navy as compact evidence and framing instead of A's full-bleed cinematic field.
Shows career movement through unlabeled calibration marks rather than a gold timeline.
Uses bright topographic grammar over the required warm transition instead of literal ivory room plans.
Demonstrates B's analytical process instrument and keeps gold as points, not a route line.
Proves the quiet section can be B-bright without using A's horizontal ledger table.
Defines the clinical contact-sheet imagery system and diagonal index rail.
Keeps accountability quiet and precise without A's warm portrait essay.
Uses the required navy close while preserving B's atlas plates and dotted decision gateway.

context_checks: All six exact brand colors are swatched with B-specific roles.
Distribution totals 100 and visibly prioritizes white and mist.
All eight final B frames appear as image-evidence thumbnails.
Gold appears as points, ticks, and action accents rather than broad decorative fields.
The final navy band is represented without turning earlier sections into A-style dark cinema.

brand_constraints: Use exact navy #0B1F3A, gold #C8A65A, mist #DCE8F2, ivory #F6F2E8, white #FFFFFF, and charcoal #38373E.
White and mist must dominate Direction B's page system.
Ivory remains nearly absent and never becomes the dominant editorial paper material.
Gold is limited to tiny decision points, selected-path markers, rail ticks, CTA arrows, and focus accents.
Avoid purple-blue SaaS gradients, invented accent hues, casino gold styling, and generic finance imagery.
art_director_rationale: Direction B turns the brand palette into a bright clinical atlas: white and mist carry orientation, navy supplies compact authority and the mandated closing band, gold is reduced to calibration, ivory recedes, and charcoal keeps compliance copy readable.
builder_freedom: The builder may vary exact section token proportions responsively if the whole page remains white/mist dominant before the required navy close.
The builder may increase or reduce tick density, but gold must stay small and structural.
The builder may use navy for CTA fills and compact panels, but not as a large cinematic field except in the final section and thin opening/transition bands.
